# Plectis is the current website

The old Will Cook homepage has been removed. This host-root address only forwards visitors to Plectis.

- [Current website](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/)
- [Start here for agents](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/llms.txt): papers, proof files, machine-readable maps and source links.
- [Related project entries](https://wcook04.github.io/agent-guide.md): Atlas and Zenith have separate websites.

Fetch the Plectis entry and follow its current routes. The removed homepage's snapshots and assets are not current research sources.
